title: Henry Tudor defeats Richard III at Bosworth Field
summary: Henry Tudor's army defeated King Richard III in Leicestershire after key nobles changed sides. Richard was killed, the last English king to die in battle.
reason: Richard III had taken the throne in contested circumstances, and Lancastrian exiles backed Henry's claim.
significance: It ended the Wars of the Roses in practice and began the Tudor dynasty.
place: Bosworth Field, Leicestershire, England, United Kingdom
